title: A free coordinate is preserved when combining sign assignments
statement: Let $y$ assign a sign in $\\{ -1,1 \\}$ to each of the free coordinates $0$ and $1$ in a four-coordinate sign vector. When $y$ is combined with the fixed assignment that gives coordinate $2$ the sign $1$ and coordinate $3$ the sign $-1$, the resulting vector has sign $y(1)$ at coordinate $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A sign assignment $y$ on the free coordinates $0$ and $1$
